name: Corsola
flavorText: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
howToObtain: Found in the wild (see locations below)

levelUp.name: Tackle
levelUp.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.

levelUp.name: Harden
levelUp.description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

levelUp.name: Bubble
levelUp.description: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

levelUp.name: Recover
levelUp.description: A self-healing move. The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

levelUp.name: Refresh
levelUp.description: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

levelUp.name: Rock Blast
levelUp.description: The user hurls hard rocks at the foe. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

levelUp.name: BubbleBeam
levelUp.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

levelUp.name: Lucky Chant
levelUp.description: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.

levelUp.name: Barrier
levelUp.description: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

levelUp.name: AncientPower
levelUp.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

levelUp.name: Aqua Ring
levelUp.description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

levelUp.name: Spike Cannon
levelUp.description: Sharp spikes are fired at the foe to strike two to five times in rapid succession.

levelUp.name: Power Gem
levelUp.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

levelUp.name: Mirror Coat
levelUp.description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

levelUp.name: Earth Power
levelUp.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tmHm.name: Water Pulse
tmHm.description: The user attacks the foe with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

tmHm.name: Calm Mind
tmHm.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tmHm.name: Toxic
tmHm.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

tmHm.name: Hail
tmHm.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

tmHm.name: Hidden Power
tmHm.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

tmHm.name: Sunny Day
tmHm.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tmHm.name: Ice Beam
tmHm.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

tmHm.name: Blizzard
tmHm.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

tmHm.name: Light Screen
tmHm.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

tmHm.name: Protect
tmHm.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Rain Dance
tmHm.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

tmHm.name: Safeguard
tmHm.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

tmHm.name: Frustration
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Earthquake
tmHm.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

tmHm.name: Return
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Dig
tmHm.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

tmHm.name: Psychic
tmHm.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tmHm.name: Shadow Ball
tmHm.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tmHm.name: Double Team
tmHm.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

tmHm.name: Reflect
tmHm.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

tmHm.name: Sandstorm
tmHm.description: A five-turn sand- storm is summoned to hurt all combatant types except Rock,  Ground, and Steel.

tmHm.name: Rock Tomb
tmHm.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.

tmHm.name: Facade
tmHm.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

tmHm.name: Secret Power
tmHm.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

tmHm.name: Rest
tmHm.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

tmHm.name: Attract
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

tmHm.name: Brine
tmHm.description: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

tmHm.name: Endure
tmHm.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Explosion
tmHm.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

tmHm.name: Rock Polish
tmHm.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

tmHm.name: Stone Edge
tmHm.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tmHm.name: Stealth Rock
tmHm.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

tmHm.name: Captivate
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

tmHm.name: Rock Slide
tmHm.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

tmHm.name: Sleep Talk
tmHm.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tmHm.name: Natural Gift
tmHm.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

tmHm.name: Swagger
tmHm.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

tmHm.name: Substitute
tmHm.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

tmHm.name: Surf
tmHm.description: It swamps the entire battlefield with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

tmHm.name: Strength
tmHm.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

tmHm.name: Rock Smash
tmHm.description: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

tutor.name: Mud-Slap
tutor.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

tutor.name: Icy Wind
tutor.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

tutor.name: Rollout
tutor.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Endeavor
tutor.description: An attack move that cuts down the foe’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

tutor.name: AncientPower
tutor.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

tutor.name: Earth Power
tutor.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tutor.name: Sucker Punch
tutor.description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.
